display.purpose: Hero headline only; Archivo wdth 62, uppercase.

band-heading.purpose: h2 inside each yellow section band.

item-heading.purpose: Service and project names; Archivo wdth 75.

spec-label.purpose: Mono caps labels on spec rows and form fields.

figure.purpose: Prices, SKUs and metrics in tabular mono.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Tab step-out, strike draw-in, count bump.

motion.name: strike-draw
motion.purpose: Hero strike lines draw left to right; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Add to Enquiry Button
components.description: Adds a catalogue item to the order slip; turns green when on the slip.
components.css: .ds-btn-add { background:#ffcc00; color:#141414; border:2px solid #141414; border-radius:0; min-height:50px; padding:0 22px; font:750 1rem/1 Archivo, sans-serif; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 85; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-add:hover { background:#ffe066; }

components.name: Send Button
components.css: .ds-btn-send { background:#141414; color:#ffcc00; border:2px solid #141414; border-radius:0; min-height:50px; padding:0 22px; font:750 1rem/1 Archivo, sans-serif; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 85; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Order-slip text field with a mono caps label.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; font:600 .75rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform:uppercase; color:#44463f; } .ds-input { display:block; width:100%; margin-top:8px; background:#fbfbf8; border:1.5px solid #141414; border-radius:0; padding:12px 14px; min-height:48px; font:400 1rem Archivo, sans-serif; color:#141414; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #ffcc00; box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #141414; }

components.name: Thumb-index Tabs
components.description: Section navigation fixed to the right edge; active tab inverts and steps out.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; align-items:flex-end; } .ds-tabs a { writing-mode:vertical-rl; width:46px; padding:16px 0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:#ffcc00; color:#141414; border:2px solid #141414; border-right:0; font:800 .85rem Archivo, sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-tabs a.on { background:#141414; color:#ffcc00; transform:translateX(-10px); } .ds-tabs b { writing-mode:horizontal-tb; background:#141414; color:#ffcc00; padding:3px 6px; font:600 .8rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Section Band
components.description: Yellow band that opens every section; its heading is the section title.
components.css: .ds-band { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-end; background:#ffcc00; border:2px solid #141414; padding:14px 28px 10px; } .ds-band h2 { margin:0; font:850 3rem/.9 Archivo, sans-serif; font-variation-settings:'wdth' 62; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-band span { font:600 .85rem 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: Hire a backend the way you order a part: numbered services with spec tables, an Add-to-enquiry control and an order slip. Cool paper, true ink, safety yellow owning whole regions, condensed Archivo and tabular mono.

rules.name: The Ground Rule
rules.body: Yellow is a surface, never text on paper.

rules.name: One Meaning for Green
rules.body: Green only says live, replaced, or selected.

rules.name: Mono Means Measurement
rules.body: Monospace for SKUs, figures and spec labels only.

rules.name: Ruled, Not Lifted
rules.body: Separate with rules and colour fields, never shadows.

dos: Give every item a SKU and a spec table
Let yellow own whole regions with ink on it
donts: No shadows, gradients, glass or rounded corners
No invented testimonials, logos or prices
